verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents CLI scripting for install, configuration, connection and removal, plus a REST API and an open-source Python module. None of the evidence shows a product feature to version, review, or roll back automations. Any versioning of user-written batch scripts would be a user-side workaround, which does not count toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
